name: How is interior trim painting done from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How is interior trim painting done from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A proper trim painting project usually starts with protecting floors and walls, then cleaning, sanding, filling defects, caulking gaps, priming where needed, and applying finish coats. Trim is often painted with a brush, though doors and some trim may be sprayed for a smoother look when the space allows. Detailed prep is what separates a sharp finish from a rushed one.
acceptedAnswer.description: The usual process is prep, sanding, caulking, priming, and finish coats. Good trim work is mostly about careful preparation and clean application.
